name: legacy-plain-log
producer: SIMULATED -- the unchained operational log the 2021-2026 incidents actually had
description: Plain JSONL, no hashes, no signatures, no markers. Mechanism: none.

loss.note: nothing accounts for a lost or deleted line

coverage.note: no enumeration of what should be logging

policy.note: no verdict carries the policy that produced it

independence.boundary_statement: the automation writes (and can rewrite) its own log
